name: AGiXT
description: AI automation platform with 40+ built-in extensions and multi-provider model support for connecting agents to real systems.
whatItDoes: Runs agents that act through extensions ranging from smart home and vehicle control to enterprise asset management. Includes OAuth and multi-tenancy for organisational deployments.
howItWorks: A pip-installed package provides an `agixt` command that starts the platform. Agents call extensions as tools and can use OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Azure or local models.
models: OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Azure, local models
